einzeiler: Resetting habits and mindset after summer with guest Ross Rayburn.
kurzfassung: Dana Perino talks with performance strategist Ross Rayburn about resetting habits and mindsets as the summer ends and a new season begins. They discuss practical ways to handle stress, including breath work and lower-stakes goal setting. Rayburn also shares his experiences with career pivoting and building an independent platform on Substack.
stichpunkte: Treating the post-Labor Day season as a natural second new year for setting intentions
Lowering the stakes of large goals by focusing on single moments of success
Using breath work to regulate emotional states and avoid choking under pressure
Transitioning from traditional yoga to teaching accessible posture, mind, and breath practices
Building an independent platform on Substack to connect directly with audiences
Embracing the courage to say 'I don't know' during a career pivot
Using humor and laughter as a tool for physical and mental regulation

clips.hook: Lowering the stakes to build sustainable habits
clips.text: Focusing on achieving a desired behavior just once serves as a successful starting point, which then builds momentum for future attempts.

clips.hook: Using breath work to handle high-pressure moments
clips.text: A prominent athlete utilized breathing techniques to recover from a historic lead loss and secure a major championship victory.

clips.hook: Why breathing is the ultimate tool you always own
clips.text: An acting coach taught that matching one's breathing to a character's physical state quickly regulates overall emotions, serving as a reliable internal control mechanism.

clips.hook: The power of admitting you do not know
clips.text: Embracing curiosity and finding the courage to admit ignorance during major life transitions helps spark genuine personal growth.

clips.hook: Why laughter keeps you young and breathing
clips.text: Maintaining a lighthearted work environment and not taking oneself too seriously helps preserve youthfulness and naturally encourages deep breathing.

beschreibung:
As summer wraps up and back-to-school season kicks off, many of us view Labor Day as a "second New Year"—a natural moment to reassess goals, reset daily habits, and pivot toward what's next. But when life moves fast, how do you make meaningful health and career changes that actually stick?

On the FOX News Rundown: Extra, Host Dana Perino speaks with author, performance strategist, and former Peloton instructor Ross Rayburn. Ross shares how to lower the stakes on overwhelming resolutions, leverage the science of breathwork to manage high-stress moments, and build the courage needed to navigate major career pivots.
